notes: Simple v1. Coverage of scenarios beats clever weights. Bump version on any weight or mapping change. Never silent-edit.

bill_pay_agent.label: Bill-due radar + pay reminders
bill_pay_agent.pattern: Watch due dates, nudge before late fees, never auto-pay without you.

subscription_audit.label: Subscription hunter
subscription_audit.pattern: List recurring charges, flag unused, one-tap cancel list.

eob_explainer.label: Insurance EOB translator
eob_explainer.pattern: Turn EOBs into 'what you owe / what to call about'.

form_filler.label: Form packet filler
form_filler.pattern: Reuse household facts onto school/clinic/insurance forms; you sign.

followup_nudge.label: Follow-up nudges
followup_nudge.pattern: If you said you'd reply, ping you before it goes cold.

calendar_deflect.label: Calendar shield
calendar_deflect.pattern: Propose times, decline junk, protect family blocks.

meeting_notes_agent.label: Meeting → next actions
meeting_notes_agent.pattern: Notes + owners + due dates after the call.

habit_nudge.label: Tiny habit pings that quit nagging
habit_nudge.pattern: One ping at the right time; silence after two ignores.

meal_plan_from_inventory.label: Meals from what's already in the house
meal_plan_from_inventory.pattern: Plan from pantry/fridge, not a fantasy grocery list.

sleep_wind_down.label: Wind-down that actually starts
sleep_wind_down.pattern: Lights/phone/schedule cue at a civil hour.

course_prune.label: Course graveyard prune
course_prune.pattern: Pick one course, archive the rest, 20-min next step.

spaced_rep_coach.label: Remember-this coach
spaced_rep_coach.pattern: Spaced questions from what you actually need to keep.

speed_to_lead.label: Speed-to-lead text
speed_to_lead.pattern: New lead → SMS in under 2 minutes with your voice; you take it from there.

quote_followup.label: Quote chase
quote_followup.pattern: Unanswered quotes get a polite bump on a schedule you set.

after_hours_sms.label: After-hours catcher
after_hours_sms.pattern: Missed call / after-hours form → text back, book or hold.

inbox_unify.label: One customer inbox
inbox_unify.pattern: FB / IG / SMS / email in one queue with drafts.

review_ask.label: Ask for the review
review_ask.pattern: After a good job, send the ask once. Never beg twice.

integration_agent.label: Stop being the human API
integration_agent.pattern: Copy the same fields between two tools you already pay for.

invoice_chase.label: Invoice chase
invoice_chase.pattern: Send, remind, escalate — you approve the tone once.

books_close.label: Monthly close packet
books_close.pattern: Uncategorized txs sorted, questions listed, you click.

inventory_sync.label: Stock vs sales matcher
inventory_sync.pattern: Flag SKUs that sales and shelves disagree on.

dispatch_assist.label: Dispatch helper
dispatch_assist.pattern: Tomorrow's jobs sequenced; gaps and double-books called out.

content_batch.label: One afternoon of posts
content_batch.pattern: Batch 8 posts from jobs you already did. You pick captions.

review_gen.label: Review → post
review_gen.pattern: Turn a 5-star into a shareable snippet.

job_screener.label: Application first-pass
job_screener.pattern: Must-have filter + 5 interview questions. You still hire.

onboarding_packet.label: Day-one packet
onboarding_packet.pattern: Checklist + forms + 'who to text' for a new hire.

shift_comms.label: Crew text that isn't chaos
shift_comms.pattern: Tomorrow's roster + one channel, not 14 group texts.

job_to_invoice.label: Job → invoice without retyping
job_to_invoice.pattern: Turn the finished job into an invoice from the same fields.

payroll_packet.label: Payroll packet
payroll_packet.pattern: Hours in, paycheck questions out — you still approve.

tax_1099.label: 1099 / contractor packet
tax_1099.pattern: Who got paid what, in a list your CPA can open.

receipt_inbox.label: Receipt inbox
receipt_inbox.pattern: Photo a receipt, it lands in the right pile.

sales_tax_packet.label: Sales-tax packet
sales_tax_packet.pattern: What to file this period, from the tools you already use.

quote_builder.label: Quote from the visit notes
quote_builder.pattern: Leave the job with a draft quote, not a blank page tonight.

crm_capture.label: Lead actually hits the CRM
crm_capture.pattern: The Facebook/Zillow name doesn't die in a screenshot.

eta_sms.label: On-the-way text
eta_sms.pattern: Customer gets an ETA without you typing it at a red light.

callback_queue.label: Callback queue
callback_queue.pattern: Missed calls become a list, not a guilt pile.

faq_replies.label: The same 8 answers, drafted
faq_replies.pattern: Draft the FAQ reply; you tap send.

complaint_watch.label: Complaint before it's a review
complaint_watch.pattern: Angry message flagged so you see it before Google does.
